#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    int arr[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    if (n % 2 == 1) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }

    map<int, int> mp;
    int ec = 0, oc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ec++;
        else oc++;
        if (ec > 0 && oc > 0 && ec == oc) {
            if (i + 1 < n) {
                mp[i] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    if (mp.empty()) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    } else if (mp.size() == 1) {
        int cost = mp.begin()->second;
        cout << (cost <= b ? 1 : 0);
        return 0;
    } else {
        int k = 0;
        for (auto& p : mp) {
            int cost = p.second;
            if (cost <= b) {
                b -= cost;
                k++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        cout << k;
        return 0;
    }
}
